verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verse_spoken: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you today and lay my restless heart before you.
You know every thought that keeps me awake and every fear I carry.
Quiet the noise in my mind, and help me fix my thoughts on you.
Where there is confusion, bring clarity, and where there is worry, bring rest.
Calm the storms in my home, my work, and my relationships.
Teach me to trust you with what I cannot control or understand.
Let your peace guard my heart when the news and the world feel heavy.
Make me a peacemaker, gentle in my words and patient with others.
Fill everyone praying with me today with your perfect peace.
